build.beforeDevCommand: npm run fetch:node --workspace musecodeicon-desktop && npm run dev --workspace @musecodeicon/web
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build --workspace @musecodeicon/web && npm run bundle:server --workspace musecodeicon-desktop && npm run fetch:node --workspace musecodeicon-desktop

security.csp: default-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
